## Purpose
A simple synthesis form that calls the blocking `toolsApi.synthesize` and reports "Tool generated successfully and moved to the Pending Review tab."

## Responsibilities
- `ToolSynthesizer` has a textarea and a button, with ErrorState.

## Key elements
`ToolSynthesizer`.

## Control flow
React rendering; data through React Query hooks where noted.

None beyond component state.

None noted.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **It looks like a legacy component.** The tools pages synthesise through background runs (`useSynthesisRun`) instead. Whether it is still mounted anywhere was not verified.
